title: 03/21/2025 - Software Updates
content:
## 03/21/2025 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103903

We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website.

- Fixed an issue where the Manual Member Geocoding page failed to function correctly in the Admin in some cases.

- Resolved a bug preventing automatic matching between members and leads when lead location data contained apostrophes. Widget Involved: Search - Member - Search Query

- Fixed an issue preventing new post comments from being saved in some cases.

- Implemented 301 redirect rule generation for "Member Write a Review", "Member Review Details", and "Member Send Message" pages when a member's profile page URL is updated.

- Fixed an issue with Member Search Results when searching by category in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Member - Search Query

- Updated the "Serves All Locations" badge on member profile pages to only appear when the "Multi-Location Listings" Add-On is active. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Badges

- Fixed an Order Summary display issue on checkout pages occurring when both the "Member Credit System" and "Easy Coupon Codes" Add-Ons were not active. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Form - Membership Payment Options

- Added functionality to search for multiple members by ID using comma-separated notation in the keyword search filter on the Search Members page in Admin. For example, searching for the keyword "#1,2,3" will return the members with IDs 1, 2, and 3.
